summary: Sealed club car park beside ovals, no homes within 90 m.
reasons: Open sealed car park, easy access

drivers.seclusion: Faces open park to the north and west; only a club building and a church hall within 50 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park off the road with marked bays and room for a van; no gate seen.
drivers.traffic: Moderate road passes 20-30 m south-west; railway further west.
drivers.convention: Club car park with daytime cars; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Rail noise from line about 150 m west
Steep spots: max 5.4% grade locally, mean 1.4%
sun_shade: Mostly open sun; trees shade the north edge and tree shadows fall from the north-west.

best_section.where: West edge of the sealed car park beside the sports club, next to the park
